text: oneil, seow: "add to an existing exposure." Answered on overlap: both seats concede MA and held V are one Financials exposure, and both frame it as which of the pair to hold, which is the PM's call, not the committee's. Closed at sector level. Still open: industry is not served, so overlap cannot be tested finer. And the two cases share one anchor, the new high at pct_from_52w_high 0.0; oneil notes it is late past the pivot, seow names the bar-low exit. The C6 test is stated; the extension stands as named.
